layout.title: How an air conditioner works

shows.does: a fan blows across a block of ice while a hot person fans themselves
the ice block melts into a puddle while the person keeps fanning
the ice goes and a coil of refrigerant takes its place and frosts
the coil's frost fades and it glows warm
a compressor appears below, shakes and pumps refrigerant round the pipes; the coil frosts again
a ring traced round the compressor
the compressor glows red hot inside the room
a hot coil and a duct appear; hot air runs up the duct to the window
hot outdoor air pushes back in round the duct at the window
a panel seals the window gap round the duct
water from the air beads on the cold coil and drips on the floor
a tray catches the drips and a hose drains the water away
the display lights, cool air blows out and the person stops fanning
the air conditioner running with the cooled person beside it

layout.why: A portable air conditioner stands cut open in a living room beside a hot person fanning themselves; the heat is followed from the room air over the cold coil, through the compressor and the hot coil, up the duct and out the window, and the water it pulls from the air down the drain hose. The camera opens close on the fan and the ice, then frames each part as it is added, and ends on the person cooled.

sentences.text: If you blow a fan across ice, you have an air conditioner.
But the ice melts, and the air warms up.
So you swap the ice for a coil of refrigerant.
But the refrigerant boils away, and the coil warms.
So a compressor pumps the gas round and squeezes it.
But the squeezed gas runs burning hot.
So a hot coil dumps that heat out a duct.
But hot outdoor air leaks back in around the duct.
So you seal the window gap with a panel.
But in the sealed room, the cold coil drips water.
So a tray and a hose drain it away.
Switch it on, and cool air blows in.
Congratulations, you built an air conditioner.

chain.shows: the ice melts into a puddle
the coil's refrigerant boils off and the coil warms
the squeezed gas makes the compressor red hot in the room
hot outdoor air leaks in round the duct at the window
in the sealed room the cold coil drips water on the floor

ideas.idea: a fan blowing across ice is an air conditioner
the ice melts and the air warms
a coil of refrigerant replaces the ice
the refrigerant boils off and the coil warms
a compressor pumps the gas round and squeezes it back
squeezing makes the gas burning hot, inside the room
a hot coil and a duct dump that heat outside
hot outdoor air leaks back in around the duct
a window panel seals the gap
the cold coil pulls water out of the room air and drips
a tray and a hose drain the water away
switch it on and cool air blows in
